table_count_policy: Do not freeze until Gate 1 dependency/data-health audit and ERD review. Never implement historical 27-table or 14-16/72/76 inventories as authority.
legacy_policy: Read-only transition sources until copy-only migration, data/GL reconciliation, two parallel payroll cycles, backup/restore, rollback and separate cutover/cleanup approval.

role_controls.owner: Independent approval of hires/compensation/legal rules/payroll/payment/final settlement/cutover; cannot be treated as qualified legal adviser without independent credential.
role_controls.hr_management: Prepare plans, requisitions, candidates, contracts, employee changes, time/leave corrections, compensation and payroll drafts; no self-approval.
role_controls.payroll_finance: Review calculations/exceptions, prepare payments/remittances, reconcile GL/PLEDGER; no changing posted history.
role_controls.branch_manager: Submit only assigned-location attendance, leave, workforce needs and evidence; no broad pay/bank/identity access or central payee payment authority.
role_controls.employee_self_service: Future optional pilot, own records only, no approval authority.
role_controls.auditor: Read-only scoped access with sensitive fields masked as policy allows.
role_controls.wordpress_administrator: Platform access stays separate from HR/Payroll business entitlements.

lifecycle.gate: Human decision with rationale; no automated final employment decision; privacy/retention controls.
No ACTIVE until signed/approved contract, verified prerequisites and approved compensation.
Corrections preserve original event and require reason plus independent approval; time premiums require approved legal rule.
Balance ledger entries are reversible by linked compensating entries, not deleted.
Effective-dated and itemized; no missing salary inference.
Exact primary source/hash, clause, effective dates, applicability and golden tests; maker cannot approve own rule.
Only APPROVED versioned legal rules; exact decimal trace; no self-approval, duplicate posting or in-place historical edits.
Unique external reference and per-beneficiary outcomes; ERP journal posting is not proof of bank settlement.
Receipt and amount/date evidence linked to rule, payroll liability and GL/PLEDGER.
Legal basis for notice/leave/severance/deductions; access/asset clearance; final payslip and reconciliation.
Five-path intake: employee payroll/benefit; expense reimbursement; digital creator; service freelancer; other exception. Never fake a supplier/employee.

acceptance_gates: Exact 49-table/source manifest, SHA, fingerprints and installed-source parity where authorized
Sanitized data-quality and reconciliation report from authorized restored clone
Reviewed ERD and old-to-new retain/reuse/replace/cutover map
Synthetic lifecycle end-to-end from approved workforce plan through final settlement/remittance
Payroll boundary tests and legal-source golden vectors signed by a qualified Ethiopian adviser
Role/location/field-scope negative tests, no self-approval and no double-post/pay
Two full parallel payroll periods and GL/PLEDGER/payment/remittance reconciliation
Exact ZIP SHA, CI receipts, backup/restore/rollback, Owner/HR/Finance and professional sign-off
